finding: The CFP credential combines four verifiable requirements and a fiduciary commitment, but it describes competence and conduct for financial advice, not how a given person is paid or whether they are registered as an adviser or broker.

takeawayPlan: A CFP professional has met four published requirements and committed to act as a fiduciary when giving financial advice; it signals planning competence but not compensation or registration, which you still verify. Evidence basis: reported (CFP Board). Changes if you need narrow investment management only (a CFA may fit) or trust work (CTFA). Next step: verify the person on the CFP Board site and Investor.gov before you hire.
